text: Allison Baby UK Limited, the authorised distributor of Joie Baby products in the UK, has Joie International Co. Limited as its immediate parent and Joie Holding Co. Ltd (incorporated in the Cayman Islands) as its ultimate parent; its ultimate controlling party is Li Yu Cheng.

source.name: Companies House: Allison Baby UK Limited, accounts for the year ended 31 December 2024
source.quote: The company's immediate parent undertaking is Joie International Co. Limited. The ultimate parent undertaking is Joie Holding Co. Ltd (incorporated in Cayman Islands).

additionalSources.name: Joie Baby UK: Terms & Conditions
additionalSources.quote: We are Allison Baby UK Limited, a company registered in England and Wales with company number 07584473. Our registered office address is at Third Floor, 20 Old Bailey, London, EC4M 7AN. We are the authorised distributor of Joie Baby products in the UK.
